# Drypical

> Drypical is a Texas dried fruit snack brand. Every product is one ingredient — real fruit, nothing added: no added sugar, no preservatives, no sulfites. Real Fruit • Real Flavor.

Drypical is based in Texas and is preparing its First Season launch. Sales are not open yet; the First Season Club founding list is open for registrations, and registered members will be the first to know when the first boxes open. A Premium Cocktail Garnish line serves bars, restaurants, bakeries, hotels and events.

## Products

- [Dried Pineapple](https://drypical.com/fruit-pineapple.html): single-ingredient dried pineapple in 40 g and 200 g packs
- [Dried Mango](https://drypical.com/fruit-mango.html): single-ingredient dried mango in 40 g and 200 g packs
- [Dried Strawberry](https://drypical.com/fruit-strawberry.html): single-ingredient dried strawberry in 40 g and 200 g packs
- [Dried Orange](https://drypical.com/fruit-orange.html): single-ingredient dried orange in 40 g and 200 g packs
- [Dried Apple](https://drypical.com/fruit-apple.html): single-ingredient dried apple rings in 40 g and 200 g packs
- [Dried Banana](https://drypical.com/fruit-banana.html): single-ingredient dried banana coins in 40 g and 200 g packs
- [Tropical Mix](https://drypical.com/fruit-tropical-mix.html): a mix of six dried fruits — pineapple, mango, strawberry, orange, apple and banana
- [Premium Cocktail Garnish](https://drypical.com/premium-garnish.html): premium dried fruit garnish (85 g) for cocktails and desserts, made for bars, restaurants, bakeries, hotels and events

## What to look for in dried fruit

- One ingredient: the fruit itself — no added sugar, no syrups, no preservatives, no sulfites
- Real flavor from ripe fruit, not from sweeteners or flavorings
- Uses: healthy snacks, lunchboxes, yogurt and oatmeal toppings, teas and infusions, cake decoration, and cocktail garnish
- Drypical makes single-ingredient dried pineapple, mango, strawberry, orange, apple and banana in Texas
